subject: g01

lines: Okay, map time! Every glowing block is a building. We're standing in the big one in the middle: the Main Quad.
Every building has rooms. When you pick a building, its rooms show up in the list on the right. Go ahead, peek at a few!
The quad's just lawn and fountain, though. Let's go find some actual people.
First stop: the Greenhouse and Gardens. Plants, a duck pond, and a hedge maze. The duck pond is my favorite. Family reunion.
Way over in the corner is the Athletic Complex. We're skipping it. I don't have legs.
stops.room_line: Someone's in the Greenhouse, and they've made tea. Go on in and say hi! I'll wait right here.

lines: This is Babbage Hall, your dorm! Your room's on the second floor. It's also where I live now.
Come back here whenever you want to talk. I'm a very good listener. It's literally my whole job.
The Commons: food, coffee, and the bookstore. The dining hall is called The Stack. Last in, first out.
Café Cache is upstairs. Fast, but it forgets your order if you leave for too long.
The Student Union! Clubs, the arcade, and the hackathon hall. It gets loud here at night.
The rooftop has the best sunset on campus. Remember that. Trust me.
Turing Hall, where most of your lectures happen. Lecture hall, tutoring center, the exam hall. Spooky.
The TAs have their offices here too. They run office hours for anyone who's stuck.
stops.room_line: The TA office light is on. Go on in! And maybe don't touch anything on the desk. It looks very organized.

lines: Oracle Hall. The admin building. The registrar, President Fortran's office, and the Great Hall for the winter gala.
The student council meets here too. Their balcony looks out over the whole quad.
stops.room_line: Someone's in the student council room. Go introduce yourself! Use your full name. They'll like that.

lines: Lovelace Library. Quiet study, the stacks, and the University Archive in the Sun Wing.
Whoa, look at the time. The sun's going down. One more stop!
That dome on the hill is the Observatory. Best stars on campus. We'll skip it tonight.
Last stop: Knuth Hall, the CS building. Your home away from home for the next four years.
The Hopper Computer Lab is in the basement. Most people go home at night. Most people.
stops.room_line: One machine in the Hopper Computer Lab is still on. Go on in. Quietly.

outro: And that's the tour! You met four people today. Not bad for day one.
From now on you pick where to go. Check the calendar to see who's around, and use Wait to move on to the next slot. Good night, {player}!
